title: רב מרי ברה דבת שמואל בר שילת

paragraphs: Rav Meri, son of Shemuel bar Shilat's daughter, in Abaye's name, Bava Batra 61b. Were I not afraid, I would say 'bar Shilat' is a scribal error and he is the preceding son of Shemuel's daughter, who also spoke in Abaye's name. Otherwise why identify him through his mother? One cannot answer as I quoted Tosafot above, that the aim was to trace him to Shemuel, like Ravna Ukva of the sons of Rav's daughter, R. Shimon ben Pazi and Abba Shaul, etc.; Tosafot should then have brought proof from this Rav Meri, son of Shemuel bar Shilat's daughter. For this reason Yuḥasin did not include him, since they are one person. [The identification and scribal-error proposal remain the source's argument.]
